requirements.ask: 关闭 GUI 不留孤儿 AUTO worker
requirements.status: DONE (and it was a real hole)
requirements.how: _kill_worker_tree() kills the whole tree (taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F) instead of terminating the venv stub the panel holds; close() uses it
requirements.evidence: measured: the panel is two processes (venv stub -> base interpreter, the second one driving the device). Killing only the stub would have orphaned it; external shutdown of the tree left no pythonw but the unrelated ollama one

defects_found_by_this_work.finding: AUTO passes no --goal, and goal discovery reads the page the client is standing on. With the device parked on the research page (queue IN_PROGRESS 4d21h), every cycle stopped by name 'research_queue_busy' and took no action at all for twenty minutes: the loop was alive and doing nothing. _leave_or_stop refuses to leave without a named goal, by design (a busy queue must not displace observations that do have work).
defects_found_by_this_work.fix: the runtime, which is the only place that knows discovery found nothing, takes one Back off TRAINING/RESEARCH when best_goal is None and no goal named the page (RuleBrain.leave_terminal_page). Pinned by the existing multitask scheduler tests, which still pass.
defects_found_by_this_work.evidence: 00:27:02 runtime snapshot: goal=AUTO_DISCOVERY skill=BACK, then AVOID_STAMINA_WASTE

defects_found_by_this_work.finding: The MuMu adapter's connect line arrives on the SAME line as the result JSON with no newline ('..."stop_reason": "..."}product: MuMuPlayer-12.0-0'), and parse_runtime_result required the whole line to be JSON -- so it returned {} for every cycle. Every stop_reason-driven decision in the panel (the 邮件→日常→联盟→探险 chain, the run summary, the escalation payload) was dead code in practice, and the window said 暂无结构化结果 while a valid 4-step result sat on the line.
defects_found_by_this_work.fix: scan for the JSON object with raw_decode instead of demanding a clean line; pinned by RunResultParseTest with the verbatim measured shape.
defects_found_by_this_work.evidence: after the fix, the real learning/control_panel/latest.log parses to stop_reason='verified_beast_target_not_visible', steps=4
